card.name: Words just before a specific detail
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "including", "cases" and "been" that come right before a named outcome or a year. Seen in drug-warning text (suicide, liver failure, Torsades) and in a few web passages.

modes.label: Before a named adverse outcome
modes.description: A linking word or noun sits right before a named serious outcome in warning text.

modes.label: "including" in a parenthesis
modes.description: The word "including" opens a parenthesis that names suicide after suicidal thoughts and behavior.
modes.example: suicidal thoughts and behavior (<<including>> suicide), tic, and tremor.

modes.label: Before a year or case name
modes.description: A space or word comes right before a year or the rest of a case title in general web text.
modes.example: a retracted<< >>1998 study linking the measles

card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a named harm, such as "including" before suicide or "cases" before liver failure.
